tools.name: find_offers
tools.description: Turns the user's request, with any context they stated (location, dates, budget, party size, preferences), into an intent and returns the offers that fit, best first, each with a tracked link to show the user (tracked_url). Matching runs in the background; when no offers are back yet, call get_offer

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: The offers ranked for an intent from find_offers, best first, only those that fit, each with its tracked link (tracked_url) and how_to_buy. offer_id is the offer's public ID: lst_ for a merchant listing (open tracked_url to book with the merchant, no sign-in), off_ for a seller's offer on Arugula. B

tools.name: explain_match
tools.description: One match with its explanation: why the offer fits the request, its fit and verification, and the draft terms (getMatch). brief: true leaves the explanation out. By using Arugula you agree to arugulanet.com/terms. Privacy: arugulanet.com/privacy.
